title: irv-metrics vocabulary
description: Contract C2. Shared definitions that dataset files refer to by id: sections, units, dimensions with their members, and boundary sets. A deployment may have several vocabulary files; they are merged, and a repeated id is an error.

sections.description: Keyed by section id, in display order.

role.description: `time`: the generic card shows a time control and time series.

members.description: Keyed by member id, in display order. Quote numeric ids: "100".

value.description: Numeric value, e.g. 100 for a 100-year return period.

range.description: Instead of `members`: integer members from `from` to `to` inclusive, each labelled with its number.

boundary_sets.description: Keyed by boundary set id, e.g. `cgaz-6.0.0`, `hydrobasins-v1c`, `wb-income-fy26`. An area id is unique within its set, across all levels.

kind.description: `admin`: nested areas that partition each country; level 0 is the country, its id the ISO3 code. `overlay`: areas drawn independently of borders, e.g. river basins; each is related to every country it overlaps. `group`: named sets of countries, e.g. continents or income groups; no geometry. Only `admin` and `overlay` are loaded in phase 1.

countries.description: `overlay` only: how areas are related to countries, by intersecting them with level 0 of an admin set at load.

min_share.description: Ignore overlaps smaller than this fraction of the area, so slivers along a border do not count.

levels.description: One entry per level. For `admin` sets, level 0 (the country) first.

level.description: Level number. Absent: the entry's position, from 0. HydroBASINS keeps its own numbers, 1–12.

label.description: Local name of the level, e.g. `Parish`, `Sub-basin`.

files.description: Path pattern of the files; `{iso3}` allowed. `admin` and `overlay`: geometry. `group`: a table with one row per (group, member country).

id.description: Column or property holding the area id.

name.description: Column or property holding the area name.

iso3.description: `admin`: the property holding the area's country; absent, `{iso3}` from the path. `group`: the column holding a member country. Not used in `overlay` sets.

parent.description: Property holding the parent area's id. Absent: found by spatial join (`admin`, `overlay`) or none (`group`).

countries.description: Per-country settings, keyed by upper-case ISO3. Optional: a country with data and no entry uses the first boundary set that has it.

boundary_set.description: The country's admin set. Must be of kind `admin`.
